Fovea player and live MJPEG foundations exist, but no concrete production ImageCraft encoded-animation preparer is wired to the exact public pin.
No physical-device deadline, memory, energy, thermal, lifecycle or reclamation evidence exists for the integrated product path.

sdWebImageDifference.interpretation: Small visual differences do not satisfy the preregistered exact-pixel digest gate. SDWebImage is reported separately and excluded from the exact-pixel timing pair.

interpretation: ImageCraft and PINRemoteImage produce identical selected-frame bytes on both fixtures, and all three comparators remain within the 1 microsecond per-frame timeline tolerance.
On this run ImageCraft is directionally faster for GIF preparation and selected-frame materialization; the 24-frame GIF window is near parity with PINRemoteImage.
On this run ImageCraft is directionally faster for APNG selected-frame materialization but slower for APNG preparation and the 24-frame APNG window.
The APNG sequence ratio differs materially from the earlier schema-1 local capture, so the old timing values are superseded rather than retroactively identity-bound.
SDWebImage cannot enter the exact-pixel pair because its output differs by up to two channel levels.
No player deadline, network, cache-footprint, lifecycle, energy, thermal or physical-device endpoint is established by this codec-only study.
